name: Mourning Lantern

Traits.name: Grief-Fed Flame
Traits.text: Whenever a creature within reach of the mourning lantern's chain dies, the mourning lantern regains 13 (3d8) Hit Points.
Traits.clause: Whenever a creature within reach of the mourning lantern's chain dies, the dim lantern-flame drinks the fading life and
Traits.expresses: grief-fed flame that flares from harmless to deadly
Traits.expressedQuote: Whenever a creature within reach of the mourning lantern's chain dies, the mourning lantern regains 13 (3d8) Hit Points.

Traits.name: Adhesive Hide
Traits.text: The mourning lantern adheres to anything that touches it. A Huge or smaller creature adhered to the mourning lantern has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13).

Actions.name: Chain Lash
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5 (with Advantage if the target is Grappled by the mourning lantern), reach 5 ft. 12 (2d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) Necrotic damage.

Actions.name: Mournful Cry
Actions.text: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 12, one creature within 60 feet. *Failure:* The target has the Frightened condition until the end of its next turn. If the target was already Frightened by this ability, it also takes 24 (7d6) Necrotic damage.

Bonus Actions.name: False Form
Bonus Actions.text: The mourning lantern shape-shifts to resemble a Medium or Small object while retaining its game statistics, or it returns to its true form. While it is motionless in its false form, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary object.

lore: A lantern carried by a traveler who died of grief on the road, its refused spirit now burns forever, luring the living close to share in a sorrow that scorches.

generation.cite: composition after Mimic (CR 2) — disguise, adhesion, and the grappled-prey advantage
